nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether public minting of Ciphersquares NFTs is enabled.
Price in wei required per NFT mint (default 0.09 ETH).
Maximum number of NFTs allowed per single mint transaction (default 20).
Hard cap on total NFT supply (3623), used for supply and starting-index modulo.
Deterministic reveal offset computed from a past block hash.

Provenance hash string for the collection, set by the owner.

Constant payable address receiving the remaining three quarters of withdrawn funds.

edges.reason: mintNFTs reads saleIsActive to gate minting.
mintNFTs reads nftPrice to compute the required payment.
mintNFTs reads maxNFTPurchase to bound the per-transaction mint count.
mintNFTs reads MAX_NFT to enforce the supply cap.
mintNFTs reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to freeze the starting index block.
mintNFTs writes startingIndexBlock when the sale completes or the reveal timestamp passes.
setMintPrice writes nftPrice.
setMaxToMint writes maxNFTPurchase.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setProvenanceHash writes NFT_PROVENANCE.
flipSaleState inverts saleIsActive.
setStartingIndex writes startingIndex derived from blockhash.
setStartingIndex uses MAX_NFT as the modulo bound.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to compute the block hash entropy.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock reads startingIndex to require it is unset.
constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp.
withdraw reads the constant recipient _tFirst.
withdraw reads the constant recipient _tSecond.
msg.sender is used directly as the mint recipient in mintNFTs.
msg.sender is passed to _safeMint and therefore into the onERC721Received callback.
block.timestamp determines REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in the constructor, a miner-influenceable timing dependency.
block.timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP lets miners influence when startingIndexBlock is frozen.
mintNFTs executes _safeMint, an external callback into the recipient contract, inside its loop.
withdraw performs external ETH transfers to fixed addresses.
setStartingIndex consumes blockhash as its randomness source.
reserveNFTs executes _safeMint on the supplied recipient inside its loop.
The onERC721Received callback triggered by _safeMint can re-enter mintNFTs before supply state settles.
A payable recipient of withdraw's transfer can re-enter the contract during the ETH send.
The onERC721Received callback triggered by reserveNFTs' _safeMint can re-enter the contract.
mintNFTs consumes its numberOfTokens parameter for validation and looping.
reserveNFTs consumes its _to recipient parameter.
reserveNFTs consumes its _numberOfTokens parameter for the mint loop.
setMintPrice consumes its _price parameter.
setMaxToMint consumes its _maxValue parameter.
setRevealTimestamp consumes its revealTimeStamp parameter.
setProvenanceHash consumes its provenanceHash parameter.
setBaseURI consumes its baseURI parameter and forwards it to _setBaseURI.
tokensOfOwner consumes its _owner parameter.
numberOfTokens controls how many times _safeMint is invoked in mintNFTs.
_numberOfTokens controls how many times _safeMint is invoked in reserveNFTs.
withdraw stores the contract balance in the total local variable.
withdraw computes the amount local as total.div(4).
the cached total (and its derived amount) flows into the external transfer.
mintIndex is the token ID passed to _safeMint in mintNFTs.
the cached supply is the base token ID passed to _safeMint in reserveNFTs.
tokensOfOwner caches balanceOf(_owner) into tokenCount.
tokensOfOwner builds the result array of token IDs.
tokensOfOwner iterates with the index loop variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter belongs to the mintNFTs signature; folding it into the function node preserves the mint-count validation semantics.
Loop counter local to mintNFTs carries no cross-function dataflow, so it is absorbed by the function.
mintIndex is the token ID fed directly into _safeMint, so it is subsumed by the unsafe mint operation.
Recipient parameter only used inside reserveNFTs; merged into the function node.
The reserve count solely determines the _safeMint loop bound, so it merges into the unsafe mint operation.
supply is the cached totalSupply used as the _safeMint token ID base in reserveNFTs.
Loop counter local to reserveNFTs with no external dataflow; absorbed by the function.
Single-use setter parameter written straight into nftPrice; merged into the setter.
Single-use setter parameter written straight into maxNFTPurchase; merged into the setter.
Single-use setter parameter written straight into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP; merged into the setter.
Single-use setter parameter written straight into NFT_PROVENANCE; merged into the setter.
Single-use setter parameter forwarded to _setBaseURI; merged into the setter.
Enumeration input used only within the view helper; merged into the function.
Intermediate cache of balanceOf inside a bounded view loop; merged into the function.
Return buffer local to the view helper; merged into the function.
Loop index local to the view helper; merged into the function.
The cached balance total directly determines the amount moved by the external transfer.
amount is the exact value sent to _tFirst by the external transfer.
